prompt: Without looking at any images, describe the most iconic image of Laughing Nailong (大笑奶龙 / 奶蛙) from memory: its pose, expression, body shape, colors, rendering style, and background, in enough detail for an artist who has never seen it to draw it. Say where you are unsure.
answer:
From memory, the iconic “大笑奶龙” image shows Nailong as a squat, extremely plump yellow baby dinosaur, laughing so hard that he resembles a frog—hence “奶蛙.”

He is viewed almost straight-on in a very low, wide-legged squat or seated crouch. His short legs spread toward the lower corners, with a large round belly hanging between them. The tiny arms are bent close to the front of the body; I am unsure whether the hands rest on the belly, thighs, or near the ground in the best-known version. The silhouette is broad and bottom-heavy: an oversized round head flows almost directly into a soft pear-shaped torso, with barely any neck, stubby limbs, and rounded feet.

His expression is the defining feature. The eyes are squeezed completely shut into two upward-curving dark lines. The cheeks lift, the snout wrinkles or bunches slightly, and the mouth opens into an enormous dark oval or rounded triangular cavity, as if he is roaring with laughter. A pink-red tongue and reddish inner mouth are visible. The head is tipped slightly back, making the laughter look uncontrolled and gleeful rather than merely smiling.

The character is saturated golden or lemon yellow, with a much paler cream-yellow muzzle and belly. Small orange-brown details—nostrils and possibly the little horn or dorsal-spike accents—break up the yellow. The eyes and mouth opening are very dark brown rather than sharply ink-black, giving the design a softer feel.

It is rendered as a polished 3D children’s-animation character: smooth rubbery or plush-like surfaces, soft studio lighting, rounded forms, subtle shadows, and no line art. The famous meme is usually isolated against a plain white or transparent-looking background, sometimes with a faint gray contact shadow beneath him. I am least certain about the precise hand placement, the number and visibility of his head/back spikes, and whether the canonical crop has a pure white background or comes from a lightly colored animation scene.
